text: {"lessons":["My account fell 5.6% in one month, so I should size positions to a level of risk I can tolerate rather than assume diversification prevents losses.","The subsequent small declines and rebound did not establish a reliable trend; past price changes are not a basis for predicting the next move.","I made no trades during these fluctuations, which helped avoid impulsive reactions; I should trade only when a clear portfolio or risk-management reason justifies it."]}
